definitions.definition: Not dependent; not contingent or depending on something else; free.

quote.citation: 2022 May 14, Jari Tanner, “Putin warns Finland NATO membership would harm relations”, in AP News‎[1], archived from the original on 14 May 2022:
quote.text: Niinisto pointed out that he had already told Putin at their first meeting in 2012 that “each independent nation would maximize its own security.”“That is still the case. By joining NATO, Finland will strengthen its own security and assume its responsibilities. It is not something away from anybody,” Niinisto said.

definitions.definition: (politics) Not affiliated with any political party.

quote.citation: 2000 October 3, Tim Paluch, “Gore vs. Bush: That's Debatable”, in Iowa State Daily:
quote.text: At one point in the debate, the moderator asked a tough question that had the candidates stumped.Moderator: "This question is for both of the candidates. Those ever-important independent voters who haven’t decided who to vote for would like to know what the real differences between you two are."Gore: "I think the real difference between Governor Bush and I is that he is in fact a Republican, and I am currently a Democrat."Moderator: "That doesn’t really answer the question, I am talking about issues."Bush: "No, he is right. I am a Republican, and he is a Democrat."

definitions.definition: Not subject to bias or influence; self-directing.

quote.citation: 1795, Robert Plumer Ward, An Enquiry into the Foundation and History of the Law of Nations in Europe from the Time of the Greeks and Romans to the Age of Grotius:
quote.text: That obligation in general, under which we conceive ourselves bound to obey a law, independent of those resources which the law provides for its own enforcement.

definitions.definition: A candidate or voter not affiliated with any political party, a freethinker, free of a party platform.

quote.citation: 2022 November 25, Sarah Baxter et al., “Britain's 15 best high streets – where Christmas shopping is a pleasure”, in The Telegraph‎[2]:
quote.text: It’s a great hub for shopping: the high street is pedestrianised and many of the town’s 600-odd listed buildings house fabulous independents – speciality food stores, cafes, antique shops, clothing boutiques.

definitions.definition: (sports) A team not affiliated with any league or conference.
